packageRules.description: Disabled by default — this Renovate config is scoped to the @orangecheck/* family ONLY. Third-party deps (next, react, tailwind, etc.) are NOT auto-tracked here; bump them by hand when you choose to.

@orangecheck/* patch + minor, bundled into one PR per consumer after a 1-day stability window. Renovate turns on GitHub's auto-merge when it opens the PR, so the merge queue takes it once the required checks pass. Renovate never merges on the checks it can read itself (only Vercel's).
Human-review @orangecheck/* major bumps — these change wire shape.
